content.content: Gate decision: ACCEPT. webapp-developer's review (mqiax8g35i) accepted the idea and confirmed the race is real (parallel Promise.all DELETEs in cleanupE2ESeeds vs unlocked file store). Reviewer corrected two framing points, both accepted: (a) README is accurately hedged (Layer B is defense-in-depth, global-setup reset is authoritative) — the bug is in the implementation, not the docs; (b) the adjacent BACKEND_PORT cosmetic sub-claim is stale (verified not present in current code) — dropped from scope, fix task explicitly told NOT to touch global-setup. Acting on accept: (1) retagged idea mqh5aew5am as 'bug', set to 'todo'; (2) repurposed reviewer-created task mqib7bbznm into the Dev task under the bug (serialize DELETEs via for...of await, assignee webapp-developer); (3) created Validate task mqic6a6qft (webapp-validator), blocked by the Dev task. No Reproduce phase: reproduction was already established in the idea and independently re-verified by the tech lead, so a redundant reproduce task would be pure overhead. No Release phase: webapp/frontend bug — completes at Validate. Marking this gate done.
